name: CircularProgressIndicator
description: A material design circular progress indicator. Indicates that an operation is ongoing. Can be determinate (with a value) or indeterminate (spinning).

properties.name: value
properties.description: The progress value, from 0.0 to 1.0. If null, the indicator is indeterminate (spinning).
properties.possible_values: Any double between 0.0 and 1.0, or null

properties.name: backgroundColor
properties.description: The color of the circle track behind the progress indicator.

properties.name: valueColor
properties.description: The color of the progress indicator. Usually wrapped in an AlwaysStoppedAnimation for a fixed color.

properties.name: strokeWidth
properties.description: The thickness of the line used to draw the circle.

properties.name: semanticsValue
properties.description: Optional semantic value describing the current progress.
